decisions.proposed_text: Tăng giới hạn Speed, Power và Wit,\nSpark giúp giảm chi phí học Skill 「Khuynh Quốc Khuynh Thành」
decisions.reason: Canonical terms are correct, but 技能折扣 means a reduction to the cost of learning the Skill; 'giảm giá Skill' is unnatural and can imply a shop discount.
decisions.terminology_basis: Preserve canonical Speed, Power, Wit, Skill and Spark while translating the gameplay discount meaning naturally.
